exports.forbidden: You do not have permission to export this community's data.
exports.csv_hint: Naming a recipient records the export as a disclosure in the provenance log. Leave it empty for internal use.
exports.pods_hint: Only the PODs of people who consented to this offer: consent is bound to its purpose. This is a snapshot — someone who withdraws stays in the recipient's copy until the next export, so how often it is repeated is how long a withdrawal takes to apply.
